title: Record export command
definitions: `smp` is the sample project's command-line tool. A record is one REQ, NFR or ADR item. The index is the JSON file of records that `smp import` writes.
must: `smp export --output <path>` MUST write every record in the index to `<path>` as a JSON array.
`smp export` MUST exit with code 0 after it writes the file.
must_not: `smp export` MUST NOT modify the index.
rationale: Reviewers compare exports between versions. An export that changed the index would hide which records the reviewed change touched.
acceptance_criteria: `smp export --output out.json` on an index of 3 records writes a JSON array of 3 records and exits 0.
The SHA-256 digest of the index is the same before and after `smp export`.
